<h2 id="t1-排列鞋子">T1 <a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P5749" title="排列鞋子" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">排列鞋子</a></h2>
<h3 id="_"></h3>
<h2 id="t2-p3459-poi-2007-meg-megalopolis">T2 <a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P3459" title="P3459 [POI 2007] MEG-Megalopolis" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P3459 [POI 2007] MEG-Megalopolis</a></h2>
<p>场切了，没有思维，全是码量。</p>
<p>还好考场上坚持调试这一题</p>
<h3 id="思路">思路</h3>
<p>首先注意到题目中给出的是一棵树。初始每一条边权为 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> ，那么修改边相当于将边权置为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>。</p>
<p>考虑把这棵树拍到 dfn 序上，并记录每个节点的深度。</p>
<p>由于每一棵子树在 dfn 序列中都是连续的。所以修改和查询操作相当于区间修改和单点查询。</p>
<p>考虑用线段树维护深度。</p>
<h3 id="代码">代码</h3>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 250005;
int cnt, n, m, dep[N], dfn[N], dfn2[N];
struct node
{
    int l, r;
} a[N];
struct tree
{
    int data, lzy;
} w[N &lt;&lt; 2];
vector&lt;int&gt; g[N];
bool InRange(int l, int r, int L, int R) { return (l &gt;= L) &amp;&amp; (r &lt;= R); }
bool OutofRange(int l, int r, int L, int R) { return (r &lt; L) || (l &gt; R); }
void pushup(int u)
{
    w[u].data = w[u * 2].data + w[u * 2 + 1].data;
}
void pushdown(int u, int l, int r)
{
    if (w[u].lzy == 0)
        return;
    w[u * 2].lzy += w[u].lzy, w[u * 2 + 1].lzy += w[u].lzy;
    int mid = l + r &gt;&gt; 1;
    w[u * 2].data -= (mid - l + 1) * w[u].lzy;
    w[u * 2 + 1].data -= (r - mid) * w[u].lzy;
    w[u].lzy = 0;
}
void build(int u, int l, int r)
{
    if (l == r)
    {
        w[u].data = dep[l];
        return;
    }
    int mid = l + r &gt;&gt; 1;
    build(u * 2, l, mid);
    build(u * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r);
    pushup(u);
}
void update(int u, int l, int r, int L, int R)
{
    if (InRange(l, r, L, R))
    {
        w[u].lzy++;
        w[u].data -= r - l + 1;
        return;
    }
    if (OutofRange(l, r, L, R))
        return;
    int mid = l + r &gt;&gt; 1;
    pushdown(u, l, r);
    update(u * 2, l, mid, L, R);
    update(u * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, L, R);
    pushup(u);
}
int query(int u, int l, int r, int L, int R)
{
    if (InRange(l, r, L, R))
        return w[u].data;
    if (OutofRange(l, r, L, R))
        return 0;
    int mid = l + r &gt;&gt; 1;
    pushdown(u, l, r);
    return query(u * 2, l, mid, L, R) + query(u * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, L, R);
}
int dfs(int x, int fa, int sum)
{
    a[x] = {++cnt, cnt};
    dfn[x] = cnt;
    dfn2[cnt] = x;
    dep[cnt] = sum;
    for (int v : g[x])
    {
        if (v == fa)
            continue;
        a[x].r = dfs(v, x, sum + 1);
    }
    return a[x].r;
}
signed main()
{
    // freopen("meg.in", "r", stdin);
    // freopen("meg.out", "w", stdout);
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for (int i = 1; i &lt; n; i++)
    {
        int a, b;
        cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; b;
        g[a].push_back(b);
        g[b].push_back(a);
        // cin &gt;&gt; dep[i];
    }
    dfs(1, 0, 0);
    build(1, 1, n);
    // for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++)
    // {
    //     cout &lt;&lt; a[i].l &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt; a[i].r &lt;&lt; endl;
    // }
    // for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++)
    // {
    //     cout &lt;&lt; dfn[i] &lt;&lt; " ";
    // }
    // cout &lt;&lt; endl;
    // for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++)
    // {
    //     cout &lt;&lt; query(1, 1, n, dfn[a[i].l], dfn[a[i].l]) &lt;&lt; " ";
    // }
    cin &gt;&gt; m;
    for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n + m - 1; i++)
    {
        char op;
        cin &gt;&gt; op;
        if (op == 'W')
        {
            int x;
            cin &gt;&gt; x;
            cout &lt;&lt; query(1, 1, n, dfn[x], dfn[x]) &lt;&lt; endl;
            // cout &lt;&lt; dep[dfn[x]] &lt;&lt; endl;
        }
        if (op == 'A')
        {
            int x, y;
            cin &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;
            update(1, 1, n, a[y].l, a[y].r);
            // for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i++)
            // {
            //     cout &lt;&lt; query(1, 1, n, a[i].l, a[i].l) &lt;&lt; " ";
            // }
            // cout &lt;&lt; endl;
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h2 id="t3-p3558-poi-2013-baj-bytecomputer">T3 <a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P3558" title="P3558 [POI 2013] BAJ-Bytecomputer" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P3558 [POI 2013] BAJ-Bytecomputer</a></h2>
<p>这道题之前考过，但是由于我之前的懒惰，一直都没有做这道题。</p>
<p>很好的一道分类讨论题。</p>
<h3 id="思路-1">思路</h3>
<h4 id="动态规划">动态规划</h4>
<p>猜测结论：按照优策略操作完后序列中只有 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。</p>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(dp[i][j]\)</span> 为第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 位变为 <span class="math inline">\(j - 1\)</span> （防止数组下标为负），且序列合法时最小的操作次数。</p>
<p>初始化：<span class="math inline">\(dp[1][a[1] + 1]\)</span> 为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，其他全为 <span class="math inline">\(inf\)</span>。</p>
<p>然后就从 <span class="math inline">\(dp[2]\)</span> 开始转移，分讨：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(a[i] = -1\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>因为 <span class="math inline">\(a[i]\)</span> 已经是 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span> 了，所以 <span class="math inline">\(dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0]\)</span>。</p>
<p>当 <span class="math inline">\(a[i - 1]\)</span> 初始为 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 时，<span class="math inline">\(a[i]\)</span> 才有可能变为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，所以 <span class="math inline">\(dp[i][1] = min(dp[i - 1][0], dp[i - 1][1]) + 1\)</span>。否则为 <span class="math inline">\(inf\)</span>。</p>
<p>同理，<span class="math inline">\(dp[i][2] = min(dp[i - 1][0], min(dp[i - 1][1], dp[i - 1][2])) + 2\)</span>。但由于前一个数可以变成一了，所以当 <span class="math inline">\(a[i - 1] != 1\)</span> 时，<span class="math inline">\(dp[i][2] = dp[i - 1][2] + 2\)</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(a[i] = 0\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(a[i] = 1\)</span> 时同理。</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="代码-1">代码</h4>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
#define int long long
const int N = 1e6 + 5;
const int inf = 1e9;
int dp[N][3], a[N], n, ans = inf;
signed main()
{
	scanf("%lld", &amp;n);
	for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i ++) scanf("%lld", &amp;a[i]);
	if(a[1] == -1) dp[1][1] = inf, dp[1][2] = inf;
	if(a[1] == 0) dp[1][0] = inf, dp[1][2] = inf;
	if(a[1] == 1) dp[1][0] = inf, dp[1][1] = inf;
	for(int i = 2; i &lt;= n; i ++)
	{
		if(a[i] == -1)
		{
			dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0];
			if(a[i - 1] == 1) dp[i][1] = min(dp[i - 1][0], dp[i - 1][1]) + 1;
			else dp[i][1] = inf;
			if(a[i - 1] == 1) dp[i][2] = min(dp[i - 1][0], min(dp[i - 1][1], dp[i - 1][2])) + 2;
			else dp[i][2] = dp[i - 1][2] + 2;
		}
		if(a[i] == 0)
		{
			dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
			dp[i][1] = min(dp[i - 1][0], dp[i - 1][1]);
			if (a[i - 1] == 1) dp[i][2] = min(dp[i - 1][0], min(dp[i - 1][1], dp[i - 1][2])) + 1;
			else dp[i][2] = dp[i - 1][2] + 1; 
		}
		if(a[i] == 1)
		{
			dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + 2;
			if(a[i - 1] == -1) dp[i][1] = min(dp[i - 1][0], dp[i - 1][1]) + 1;
			else dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
			dp[i][2] = min(dp[i - 1][0], min(dp[i - 1][1], dp[i - 1][2]));
		}
	}
	for(int i = 0; i &lt;= 2; i ++)
	{
		ans = min(ans, dp[n][i]);
	}
	// printf("%lld %lld %lld\n", dp[n][0], dp[n][1], dp[n][2]);
	if(ans &gt;= inf) cout &lt;&lt; "BRAK" &lt;&lt; endl;
	else cout &lt;&lt; ans &lt;&lt; endl;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<h4 id="贪心">贪心</h4>
<p>还有个贪心解法的，但是我还没有学懂。</p>
